_readme: Bounding boxes for mapsee_ingest_osm_food.py — takeaway places from OpenStreetMap
that have a resolvable order link AND readable opening hours. Both filters are
hard: no order link or unreadable hours means the place is skipped, because a
pin with nothing behind it, or hours we guessed at, is worse than no pin.
bbox is [south, west, north, east]. Keep them TIGHT. Measured while building
this: a wide Seattle box answered 504, and a third city queried back-to-back
answered 429. Overpass is free and volunteer-run and it will say so.
1,086 food places -> 654 with a website -> 446 tag opening_hours
-> 317 whose hours we can READ -> 9 of the first 25 examined (36%) had a
real order link once gift cards are excluded. Extrapolated: ~110 per box.
Do not expect thousands. Expect tens, all of which actually work.
_not_included is an editorial NO and anything proposing new areas must read
it — same convention as mobilizon_sources.json. Put a MEASUREMENT in it, not
an impression: an earlier draft of this file declined Tokyo and Paris on a
guess that their opening_hours coverage was thin, and both turned out fine
(Shibuya 127 readable, Paris 11e 143). The guess would have cost two cities.
